name: Cowork Ubuntu 22.04 arm64

durableRegistrationOptions: Register this stack as an MCP server through Cowork connector/MCP settings if supported.
Run the stack on a persistent machine as a local or remote MCP server and connect Cowork to that server.
Install through RUDI on a persistent host with rudi install stack:audio-tools, then expose it through MCP.

optionalForEnrichment: local agent command compatible with AUDIO_TOOLS_AGENT_*
notes: Use npm/npx commands on Cowork; do not assume yarn or pnpm.
Install Python packages with pip using --break-system-packages when required by the sandbox policy.
.stack is a RUDI archive convention, not a Cowork-native install/uninstall unit.
Manual Cowork shell setup is useful for one-off demos only because node_modules, compiled binaries, models, and installed packages are not durable across conversations.
Cowork MCP/plugin tools may run in a separate runtime from the interactive bash shell; dependencies must be visible to the actual MCP server process, not only to the shell used for diagnostics.
Do not package node_modules, dist, .env files, transcript outputs, databases, caches, or local model files in audio-tools.stack.
